Keep all hidden text when enabled

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"never\"},\"content\":{\"exclude_selectors\":[],\"extract_metadata\":false,\"keep_hidden\":true,\"preprocessing_preset\":\"minimal\",\"remove_forms\":false,\"remove_navigation\":false},\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.markdown()?.content() as Any)
```
